The '''Nooli system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Noolian Crisis]] of [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the Nooli system was seized by [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] who were subsequently defeated in the [[Battle of Galboron]] by a task force led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Par Lankin]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
